# Trammel

Std-only planning binary for coding agents. Version 4.0.0. JSON on stdout.

- `trammel doctor` — store, languages, protocols, next step
- `trammel decompose --goal "..." --project-root .`
- `trammel start_plan --goal "..." --project-root .`
- `trammel verify_step --project-root . --edits '[...]'`
- `trammel mcp` — stdio MCP, protocols 2026-07-28, 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18
- Install the binaries with `npm i -g trammel-mcp` or `npx trammel-mcp`. The commands are `trammel` and `trammel-mcp`.

Contract: docs/LLM_CONTRACT.md
Guide: AGENTS.md
